title: CSV export
summary: A Download CSV button for any table, with a preview of the first rows.
description: A custom component that gathers the rows of one table the viewer is allowed to see (up to 5,000, newest first) and offers them as a CSV file that opens in any spreadsheet. Pick the columns or let it use every field. The template adds it with an Export page for the role you choose.

params.name: entity
params.label: Table to export
params.description: The table the Export page offers as CSV.

params.name: page_role
params.label: Who sees the Export page
params.description: The role the Export page is for.

highlights: Exports only rows the viewer may see
No server code: built in the browser
